scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for Assistance to Mega Industries: Reimbursement of Stamp Duty and Registration Fees
other_conditions: Minimum investment of ₹2,500 crore in plant and machinery
Must provide direct employment to at least 2,500 persons
Must belong to one of the thrust sectors as defined in the Guidelines
Land must be purchased or leased during the eligible investment period
Unit must have commenced commercial production
benefits_summary: Eligible mega manufacturing units can claim 100% reimbursement of stamp duty and registration fees paid for land purchase or lease.
